identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Docetaxel and Cisplatin Combined With Nimotuzumab As First-Line Treatment in Patients With Recurrent or Metastatic Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Open-Label, Multicenter, Phase Ⅱ Study of Docetaxel and Cisplatin Combined With Nimotuzumab As First-Line Treatment in Patients With Recurrent or Metastatic Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this single arm,phase Ⅱ clinical trail is to determine the safety and efficacy of docetaxel and cisplatin combined with Nimotuzumab in the treatment of recurrent and metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma

armGroups.label: Docetaxel and Cisplatin and Nimotuzumab
armGroups.description: All eligible patients received intravenous nimotuzumab plus docetaxel and cisplatin every 3 weeks for a maximum of 6 cycles, or until disease progression, death, intolerable toxicity.
interventionNames: Drug: Docetaxel and Cisplatin and Nimotuzumab

interventions.name: Docetaxel and Cisplatin and Nimotuzumab
interventions.description: Intravenous nimotuzumab (200 mg on days 1, 8, and 15) ; Intravenous docetaxel (75 mg/m2 on day 1) ; Intravenous cisplatin (75 mg/m2 on day 1) ;

primaryOutcomes.description: the proportion of patients achieved partial response (PR) and complete response (CR) according to RECIST v1.1

secondaryOutcomes.description: the proportion of patients achieved CR, PR, or stable disease \[SD\]
time interval from the first day of documented response to progressive disease \[PD\] or death from any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of documented response until the date of progressive disease [PD] or death, whichever came first, assessed up to 12 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: time interval from the enrolled date to the documented PD or death from any cause or censored at the last follow-up
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of the enrollment until the date of the documented PD or death, whichever came first, assessed up to 12 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: time interval from the enrolled date to death from any cause or last follow-up
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of the enrollment until the date of the documented death, assessed up to 72 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: treatment-related adverse events graded for severity according to the National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 4.0
